items.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.desc: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.desc: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability…

items.title: CVE-2026-123890 — VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.title: CVE-2025-42884 — SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.desc: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
items.desc: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: CVE-2026-63077 — JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.desc: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

items.title: CVE-2026-15409 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.desc: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.
